name: Cobb Salad with Bacon, Egg, Cheese, Avocado, Tomato & Dijon Vinaigrette (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate, then set aside.

While the bacon is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the vinaigrette. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 pint grape tomatoes
½ English cucumber
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Place on a plate.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the tomatoes, keeping them separate.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the plate.
Peel and quarter eggs. Add to the plate and set aside.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide a ⅓-cup each of tomatoes, cucumber, and avocado between plates, then add 4 pieces of egg. Serve with crackers and Thousand Island dressing for dipping. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide lettuce between bowls. Top with crispy bacon, remaining tomatoes, cucumber, avocado, egg, and cheese. Drizzle with vinaigrette and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
12 multigrain cracker
⅓ cup Thousand Island dressing
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
